command: SELECT json_build_object('nonpublic_schemas',coalesce((SELECT json_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname NOT IN ('public','information_schema') AND nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%'),'[]'::json),'other_connections',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()))
